Gelato v0.6.9 checkpoint fixtures

The three gelato-v069-*-profile.json files were generated by the archived
v0.6.9 runtime, using its original data and launch physics. They contain only
synthetic test progress. No player save was read or copied.

Capture script and source-hash evidence:
verification/twin-economy-20261102/capture-v069.gd
verification/twin-economy-20261102/capture-v069.log
verification/twin-economy-20261102/content-change.json

Original content fingerprint:
9cf438255f4930f41ece8847325d238aaed8756564842abd6339119bc7a6f1d6

Cases: single launcher, previously owned twins and a fixed-loadout Trial.
All three have unfinished runs with real spawned balls. The twins campaign
is intentionally at tray 5 with rebuilt Power 1 and reset tier 3, proving
that later shop requirements cannot revoke previously purchased launchers.
Bakery wallet and Trial records provide cross-area preservation checks.

The tests load each immutable fixture into an explicitly isolated temporary
profile. Integer/double JSON representation and Vector2 float reconstruction
are compared numerically within 1e-10; RNG state is compared as exact strings.
Fixtures are excluded from all game exports under tests/**.
